description: Post-D2 forward arc for Rizwan Shah — RAW operative, Hamza's protégé and Film 2/3/4 ground lead. Younger generation Naya-Bharat operator; less deep-cover stress than Hamza but greater operational tempo across Punjab/Karachi/diaspora theatres.
notes: Rizwan's arc is more domestic-balanced than Hamza's — emphasis on Punjab and diaspora. Lower mortality, higher attribution risk because operations cross into Canada/UK.

actions.label: Lead Punjab narco-Khalistan ground op
actions.description: Continue rolling up Faizal/Gurbaaz/Prabhneet network and MLA Sukhwinder political cover.

actions.label: Run diaspora SFJ / BKI Canada operation
actions.description: Penetrate Canadian Khalistan diaspora funding chain. High strategic value, very high attribution risk (Nijjar-style fallout).

actions.label: Take over Hamza's Karachi handler role
actions.description: Step into Hamza's Karachi network as offshore handler. Multiplier on existing assets without new field exposure.

actions.label: Disrupt UAE/Balkan ISI logistics chain
actions.description: Lateral op — break the hawala / arms transit through Dubai-Karachi-Sarajevo. High mission yield, lower attribution.

actions.label: Consolidate domestic Punjab counter-radicalisation
actions.description: Embed with state police / NIA on the Indian side — slower yield but builds durable Punjab CT capacity.

actions.label: Run kinetic in-Pakistan response to Pahalgam
actions.description: Direct-action operation against TRF/LeT control nodes inside Pakistan. Highest yield, highest cost.

actions.label: Request extraction
actions.description: End field career; rotate to RAW HQ.

events.label: Post-D2 canon close — Punjab op continuity
events.description: Punjab ground network mostly rolled up; ISI shifting to diaspora-only mode. Decision: stay in-theatre, pivot offshore, or consolidate domestically.

events.label: ISI counter-intel sweep
events.description: ISI tightens Karachi screws. Rizwan must decide whether to absorb the handler-pivot or stay focused on Punjab.

events.label: Khalistan diaspora radicalisation surge
events.description: Canadian SFJ chapter pushes referendum + funding wave; diaspora-Punjab nexus tightens.

events.label: Pahalgam attack — TRF kills civilians
events.description: Demand for in-Pakistan kinetic option spikes; Rizwan is one of few field operatives positioned to enable.

events.label: Operation Sindoor planning window
events.description: Final operational window before kinetic phase. What Rizwan does here defines the projection horizon.
